title: "Blest Are the Meek," He Said
description: "Blest Are the Meek," He Said in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 348 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"Blessed are the Meek."”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: "Blest are the meek," he said, Whose doc-trine is di-vine; The hum-ble mind-ed earth pos-sess, And bright in heaven will shine.

lines: And bright in heaven will shine.
While here on earth they stay,
Calm peace with them shall dwell,
And cheerful hope and heavenly joy
The God of peace is theirs;
And yielding all their wills to him,
That all we hope, or wish, may be

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
